g.text: Exact in law. Delayed, incomplete, and state-dependent in the record.
Final four-cohort UDISE analysis at the 250/251 pupil cutoff.
India’s Composite School Grant is deterministic on paper. Its UDISE fingerprint is neither immediate nor uniform.
A SHARP RULE BECOMES A FAN OF ADMINISTRATIVE OUTCOMES
